26-043 Surfside Well Drilling ITT

Status
Open
Post Date
November 6, 2026
Closing Time
December 1, 2026 at 3:00 PM

The Regional District of Nanaimo is inviting tenders from qualified and experienced contractors for the drilling one 12-inch diameter water supply production well and associated works at a selected location in the Surfside Water Service Area, located north of Qualicum Beach. A non-mandatory pre-tender meeting will be held on November 17, 2026 (Tuesday) at 2:00 PM Local Time.

All tenders must be accompanied by a verifiable digital Bid Bond and a verifiable digital Consent of Surety as defined by the Surety Association of Canada. Scanned copies are not acceptable.

Questions and Submissions are to be directed to:

Rocky Chowdhury, M.Sc., P.Eng.
Project Engineer, Water Services
Regional District of Nanaimo
6300 Hammond Bay Road, Nanaimo, BC V9T 6N2
Email: rchowdhury@rdn.bc.ca
